file_reviews.assessment: Full manuscript inspected. Section 1 defines the graded complex. Section 2 derives the C3 degree separation instance for Gamma2. Section 5 and 13 establish projection invariants and rewrite rules. Section 6 derives sign loss under magnitude aggregation from the triangle inequality.
Claim ledger inspected. C02 (degree separation theorem C3 instance), C03 (pi_Z projection invariants), C04 (rewrite rules), C05 (coarse-graining asymmetry), and C19 (diagnostic routing rule) checked.
Core implementation inspected. Implements create_c3_complex, DegreeWiseDSLState, compute_phi1, compute_gamma2, and invariant validation.
Test suite inspected. Contains test_c02_degree_separation_c3, test_c03_projection_invariants, test_c04_rewrite_rules, test_c05_coarse_graining_asymmetry, and test_c19_diagnostic_routing_rule.
Lean 4 mechanization inspected. Formalizes C3 degree separation instance c3_degree_separation_instance, DeclaredProjection rewrite contracts, and squared-aggregate sign collision.

claims.statement: On C3, the integer l1 distance from (1,0,0) to im d0 is 1 with or without a 2-cell, while Gamma2 = ||d1 h||_1 is undefined without the 2-cell and equals 1 with it.
dependencies: Oriented triangle 1-skeleton graph C3 and optional single 2-cell.
Integer cochain spaces C0, C1, and C2.
Quotient l1 distance definition Phi_1 and closure defect definition Gamma_2.
claims.limits: Established for the integer C3 instance; general-k degree separation is schematic and unproved.

claims.statement: A supplied rational projection matrix pi_Z is admitted if and only if pi_Z^2 = pi_Z and pi_Z d0 = 0 hold exactly.
dependencies: Finite rational cochain complex with discrete coboundary d0.
claims.limits: Applies to declared rational projection matrices; projection choice is non-unique.

claims.statement: For any graded complex with d1 d0 = 0 and any admitted projection pi_Z, Rules 1-3 hold: d1 d0 = 0, pi_Z^2 = pi_Z, pi_Z d0 = 0, and quotient defect is invariant under exact shifts.
dependencies: Admitted cochain complex with nilpotency d1 d0 = 0.
Certified projection invariants pi_Z^2 = pi_Z and pi_Z d0 = 0.
Quotient defect norm invariance under translation by im(d0).
claims.limits: Conditioned on prior certification of projection invariants; rewrite rules are unsound for unadmitted operators.

claims.statement: On finite real lists, |sum x_i| <= sum |x_i| with equality if and only if all nonzero elements share a sign; magnitude and squared aggregates do not determine individual signs.
dependencies: Finite real sequences and standard l1 triangle inequality.
Equality condition for the l1 triangle inequality.
claims.limits: Establishes non-invertibility from magnitude and squared aggregates alone; does not restrict models with preserved orientation data.
